metadata.name: CardText
metadata.label: Card Text
metadata.value:
Enter the Pokémon Stadium—Ready for Battle!

Build two decks from a powerful set of components—and then play right away, with this two-player Build & Battle Stadium set! Each Pokémon Trading Card Game: Sword & Shield—Brilliant Stars Build & Battle Stadium contains a massive set of cards, including two Build & Battle Boxes, one for you and one for a friend. Each Build & Battle Box holds four booster packs and a 40-card deck, which includes an exclusive foil card—you can play these decks as-is right out of the box, or enhance them with cards from the boosters! Get ready to face your opponents with the Pokémon TCG: Sword & Shield—Brilliant Stars Build & Battle Stadium!

The Build & Battle Stadium includes everything you need for two players to prepare and battle. Inside this box, you’ll find::

• 2 individual Build & Battle Boxes, each containing a 40-card ready-to-play deck

• Each deck includes 1 of 4 unique foil promo cards

• 4 additional Pokémon TCG: Sword & Shield—Brilliant Stars booster packs, so you get 12 in all

• 121 Pokémon TCG Energy cards

• 6 damage-counter dice

• 1 competition-legal coin-flip die

• 2 acrylic condition markers

• A collector’s box to hold everything

metadata.value:
Case Contains 6 Arceus V Figure Collection

Power Up Your Pokémon—with Arceus V!

The majestic Alpha Pokémon is bringing a boost of power to your team—and an awesome figure to your collection! In this set, you get a playable foil promo card featuring Arceus V and a beautifully detailed Arceus figure to lend you inspiration in battle, as well as a handful of Pokémon TCG booster packs to keep the fun going.

Each collection comes with:

• 1 foil promo card featuring Arceus V

• 1 sculpted Arceus figure

• 4 Pokémon TCG booster packs

These Pokémon Are Ready to Join Your Team!

Get in on the latest Pokémon TCG action with an awesome booster pack, two promo cards, a cool Pokémon coin to add to your collection, and a code card for Pokémon TCG Live! The Pokémon TCG: Sward & Shield-Brilliant Stars expansion contains over 170 cards.

Each Pokémon TCG: Sword & Shield-Brilliant Stars booster pack contains 10 cands and either 1 basic Energy or 1 VSTAR marker. Each player must have a 60-card deck of Pokémon cards to play.

Expand your Pokémon Trading Card Game collection with "10 Additional Game Cards" booster packs.
